paper_title: Search of spin-dependent fifth forces with precision magnetometry
coupling_convention: g_p^e * g_s^N (electron pseudoscalar x nucleon scalar coupling product), dimensionless, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Crescini et al. (QUAX-gpgs upgraded setup, SQUID magnetometer with GSO paramagnetic crystals) searching for monopole-dipole spin-mass forces. Flat limit g_p^e g_s^N <= 5.7e-32 at 95% CL stated valid for lambda >~ 10 cm; encoded as mass-independent bound from m ~ 4.1e-12 eV (lambda ~ 300 km, upper edge of quoted improvement range) to m = 1.24e-5 eV (lambda = 10 cm). Paper also quotes electron-electron coupling g_p^e g_s^e <= 1.6e-31, not encoded here. Full lambda-dependent exclusion curve only shown in Fig. 4 (not numerically extractable from text); the flat value is the paper's headline number.
